text: Chapter 10: The Lost God's Ship@The Goddess of Courage and the Squatters
Before asking Grecia to tell the Injes to leave,\nhead to Calle Mort in order to help her purify\nthe spirits that have turned evil!
Together with Grecia and Burnos, purify the evil\nspirits that are drifting in Calle Mort and send\nthem to the Dark Realm!
